links.outcome: Whether an automated ML model predicts expert-rated accuracy and completeness of LLM responses
links.effect: Accuracy prediction MAE 0.261 (11.6% lower than the mean baseline), rho 0.202 (p=0.004), but R² -0.161; Completeness MAE 0.294, R² -0.106. Weak signal only.
links.quote: Combining NLP, semantic, and explainable textual features provided a measurable signal for predicting expert Accuracy scores; however, negative R² values indicate that automated quality prediction remains limited in the present dataset.

unlisted_practices: Using NLP and semantic-similarity features with machine learning to pre-screen LLM response quality
Comparing multiple LLMs on patient education questions using expert ratings

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLM response quality to orthopedic questions and tests whether ML models can predict expert-rated quality, without testing an implemented organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
